content:
alex: hey team — releasing the first RC of the "iac-connector-kit" for CloudPartner X. need quick sanity checks on the terraform module + example template today if possible :eyes:
meera: on it. i'll run the smoke tests against our gke lab and report back by EOD. any particular tests to hit?
alex: focus on: module inputs validation, iam role propagation, and multi-region example. also ensure the module plays nicely with CP marketplace packaging.
jamal: i'll do a dependency lint pass (tfsec + tflint) and a basic plan/apply in a throwaway proj. sending notes if anything weird.
tasha: tagging @devex — any docs that need updating for quickstart? i can draft short snippets for the console and partner docs.
devex: thanks — i'll update the quickstart README and add a short debug section. share any CLI flags you want surfaced.
liam: infra-bot kicked off a dry-run for the example template in ap-southeast-1. results: plan succeeded, one warning about service account role too broad. attaching snippet:
```
module "cp_connector" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-iac//modules/connector?ref=rc-0.1"
  name   = "cpx-connector"
  region = "ap-southeast-1"
}
```
jamal: saw the same warning locally — we should tighten the role scope before GA. i can PR a narrower policy and add a test.
partner-eng: fyi from CP side — marketplace packaging requires a minimal set of perms and a validated template schema. we flagged the role issue to their compliance team earlier today.
meera: smoke tests passed for deployment and basic inference routing, latency within expected bounds. i noted a small env var mismatch on the example that caused a 502 on first boot — easy fix in README.
alex: awesome. can we get a checklist and owners? propose:
- iam role scoping: jamal
- marketplace schema validation: partner-eng + jamal
- quickstart docs + fix env var: tasha + devex
- automated smoke tests + CI matrix: meera
- release packaging + tag: alex
any objections?
jamal: ack and on it. will open PR with role change and CI test.
partner-eng: ack, will coordinate schema signoff with CP legal tomorrow morning.
tasha: i'll update the README now and push a tiny example to the repo.
infra-bot: deploy-check | sandbox-ap-southeast-1 | plan: success | apply: skipped (dry-run)
alex: timeline — want RC promoted to candidate tomorrow 16:00 PT if all owners sign off. if anyone needs more time call it out now.
meera: that timeline works for me.
jamal: likely fine, may need a couple hours for the role PR review.
partner-eng: we may need until 09:00 PT to confirm marketplace schema signoff, but PMC team is looped.
alex: ok noted. i'll hold the promotion until partner-eng confirms. thanks everyone — post any blockers here and i'll coordinate final packaging. :thumbsup:
